text:
elaine: Hey team — quick design huddle. Mock attached: sidecar panel now has Export CTA, Copy Correlation ID, and a small 'More' overflow. Trying to figure ideal order + copy for screen readers. Thoughts?
noah: I like Export first visually. It's the primary action. But keyboard order should match visual order.
sam: +1 Export primary. For copy: 'Download trace' vs 'Export trace' — which is clearer to customers?
rachel: From a11y POV 'Download trace' implies a file saved to disk; 'Export trace' is more generic. If we produce JSON vs .har, maybe 'Download trace (JSON)' or use aria-describedby to clarify.
kevin: We often default to 'Export trace' in other screens. Consistency wins. Maybe change label to 'Export trace — JSON' when format is JSON.
elaine: Good notes. What about copy for correlation ID action? Currently 'Copy correlation ID' which reads fine but voiceover reads the whole panel; should we prefix with context? e.g., 'Copy correlation ID for this request'.
rachel: Short is better. Screen reader can announce nearby header: 'Request details — correlation ID: abc123'. The action should be 'Copy ID' to be succinct. ARIA-label could be 'Copy correlation ID for current request'.
noah: Also need to decide if Copy ID shows a toast only or also announces via aria-live region for SR users. Toast isn't accessible by default.
kevin: We have an aria-live region on top-level notifications but it's gated by user prefs. For critical copy confirmation we should add an immediate aria-live announcement: 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard'.
sam: Small UX question: overflow 'More' contains 'Open in new tab' and 'Export raw events'. Is that discoverable? Maybe expose 'Open in new tab' as primary because it's common.
elaine: Hm — that could push Export down. I worry about clutter. Maybe keep export as primary and move 'Open in new tab' into the header action group as a lightweight icon button with tooltip.
rachel: Keyboard focus: when the sidecar opens focus should land on the first interactive element in header (close button or first action?). For SR users, landing on header title may be better, then allow tab to actions.
noah: Agreed — focus the panel title (h2) and set role='dialog' with focus trap. Actions still reachable immediately.
elaine: Copy of export CTA: suggestion 'Export trace (JSON)' and smaller secondary 'Copy ID' action. Also add aria-labels: code block below proposed: ```<button aria-label="Export trace as JSON">Export trace (JSON)</button> <button aria-label="Copy correlation ID for current request">Copy ID</button>```
kevin: Looks good. Small nit: use consistent punctuation — we avoid parentheses in button text usually. So maybe button text 'Export (JSON)' or use an icon to indicate format.
sam: Could we show format as a subtle badge next to CTA instead of in label? That keeps label concise. e.g., [Export] [JSON].
rachel: If you show as badge, ensure badge has aria-hidden=true and button aria-label includes the format. Otherwise SR misses format.
elaine: Nice catch. I'll update mock: Export primary, small JSON badge visually, aria-label includes format. Add aria-live on copy. Anyone object to keeping Copy ID as second action inline next to Export?
noah: No objections. Just ensure spacing for touch targets and truncation for long IDs.
kevin: Also add a copy icon svg with title and aria-hidden for visual only, plus sr-only text 'copy' for screen readers.
elaine: Great. I'll iterate and post updated frames. Thanks! :sparkles:
